title: Nurse says the Wright Patterson craft came from Aztec
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Nurse says the Wright Patterson craft came from Aztec, about unspecified at Wright Patterson, Dayton, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That's how they found out it came from Aztec. She claimed it came from Aztec

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher of a claimed crash near Aztec, a small town in New Mexico, passes on what a nurse told about a craft held at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base near Dayton, Ohio. According to Ramsay, the nurse said the craft there had come from Aztec, and that this is how the link was made. If true, it would tie the Aztec crash story to the military holding the wreck.
